title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass for reliable everyday use. Designed as part of the Carolina Collection, this straight bar helps keep towels within reach while saving space.

Highlights:
- Solid brass construction for enduring strength
- Wall-mounted design helps free up bathroom floor space
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look
- Mounting plates and installation hardware included
- Coordinates with other versatile bath accessories in the Carolina Collection

Specs:
- Collection: Carolina Collection
- Style: Traditional
- Bar shape: Straight bar
- Center-to-center: 30 in
- Bar diameter: 0.75 in
- Overall size: 30 in L x 2 in W x 3.5 in H
- Projection: 2 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Included: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
- Finish options: Multiple designer finishes available
